orphans.title: Left behind
orphans.none: Every build folder here belongs to a project.
orphans.note: Uncached will not remove these. A build folder is only ever a target when the project file that owns it sits beside it. Open one to decide for yourself.
orphans.exception: The environments above are the exception: without the project's dependency file, no command can rebuild one.
